what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Bangladesh in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 10747 Bangladeshi asylum seekers in the United States, 11.6% of all asylum seekers from Bangladesh.
Refugees from Bangladesh, a separate group, live mostly in France, Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Bangladesh with the PBCP and PBCP-J in 2005 and 2006, and with the Islamic State group in 2016 and 2017.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1213 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 18480, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
